summary: Pin is on a garden footpath; nearest real stop is the busy visitor car park.

drivers.seclusion: No homes nearby; car park backs onto gardens, but it is the main visitor hub with buildings and staff around.
drivers.access_and_room: The pin sits on a narrow footpath among plantings with no vehicle tracks; the sealed car park has a road in and plenty of room.
drivers.traffic: Daytime tourist traffic; quiet after hours.
drivers.convention: Public gardens car park, no sign of overnight stays; closing hours unknown.

flags: Slope data is sampled at the pin (mean 8.5%), not the car park
Pin is off: on a garden footpath
sun_shade: Car park is open to sun all day with some trees on its edges.
cannot_judge: Car park closing hours or overnight rules

best_section.where: Asphalt visitor car park beside the Planetarium, about 94 m north-east of the pin
